-- sys/go.mod --
module golang.org/x/sys

go 1.27

-- sys/plan9/plan9.go --
package plan9

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Syscall(trap, a1, a2, a3 uintptr) (r1, r2 uintptr, err syscall.ErrorString) {
	return syscall.Syscall(trap, a1, a2, a3)
}

//go:noinline
func Syscall6(trap, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 uintptr) (r1, r2 uintptr, err syscall.ErrorString) {
	return syscall.Syscall6(trap, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6)
}

//go:noinline
func RawSyscall(trap, a1, a2, a3 uintptr) (r1, r2, err uintptr) {
	return syscall.RawSyscall(trap, a1, a2, a3)
}

//go:noinline
func RawSyscall6(trap, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 uintptr) (r1, r2, err uintptr) {
	return syscall.RawSyscall6(trap, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6)
}

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/adep v0.0.0
	golang.org/x/sys v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

replace golang.org/x/sys => ../../sys

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_exec_allowlist = ["golang.org/x/sys/**"]
transitive_net = "deny"
transitive_net_allowlist = ["golang.org/x/sys/**"]

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/adep"

func main() { adep.Init() }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

require golang.org/x/sys v0.0.0

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

import "golang.org/x/sys/plan9"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	plan9.Syscall(0, 0, 0, 0)
	plan9.Syscall6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	plan9.RawSyscall(0, 0, 0, 0)
	plan9.RawSyscall6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
}

go 1.27

-- d/dep/dep.go --
package ddep

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.Getpid()
	os.Getpid()
	os.ReadFile("go.mod")
}
